label: t04_01
text: Welcome to Artazon, a town where the flowers\nare as bright and colorful as the artwork!

label: t04_09
text: Look at the conflict on this Sunflora’s face! What\ncould the artist have been feeling?

label: t04_12
text: I told my girlfriend clear as day, “let’s meet at the\nweird sculpture!” What’s taking her so long?

label: t04_26
text: My boyfriend said we’d meet at “the weird\nsculpture,” but that hardly narrows it down...

label: t04_31
text: Come on in and see if you can reach the center\nof Artazon’s famous hedge maze!

label: t04_36
text: When the spring winds start to blow, Sunkern\ncome riding in on ’em.

label: t04_58
text: Hmm, yes. Highly conceptual, accentuated with\ncontrasting modalities. Not that an amateur\r\nwould pick up on all that.

label: t04_64
text: I came to see this famous piece! I can’t say I\nreally get it, but I like it!

label: t04_65
text: Aw, not another dead end! I’m so lost...

label: t04_69
text: Whoa, you actually found your way here! Nice!\c\nAlmost no one ever makes it this far, so I decided\nto make it into my secret base!

label: t04_74
text: If you get worn out, try stopping for a breather.\nYou might notice things you didn’t before.

label: t04_76
text: I can’t believe Sunkern turn into Sunflora when\nthey evolve! Evolution’s wild!

label: t04_105
text: Check out my Cyclizar! We’re going on all sorts\nof journeys together!

label: t04_115
text: This must be a Brassius original! Though the style\nseems a little...off.

label: t04_118
text: I love high places! I heard outside of town, there\nare big, tall watchtowers in some places!
